name: dependency-audit
description: Scan dependency lockfiles (requirements.txt, package-lock.json, Cargo.lock, go.mod) for known vulnerabilities using the free OSV.dev database. No credentials required.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: deps.audit
tools.description: Parse a dependency lockfile and check every package against the OSV.dev vulnerability database. Returns only packages that have known vulnerabilities, plus scanned/vulnerable counts.

content.description: The full text of the lockfile to scan

filename.description: Filename hint used to pick the parser: requirements.txt, package-lock.json, Cargo.lock, or go.mod

ecosystem.description: Optional OSV ecosystem override (e.g. PyPI, npm, crates.io, Go). Defaults to the one implied by filename.

tools.name: deps.query_package
tools.description: Look up known vulnerabilities for a single package at a specific version via OSV.dev.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem, e.g. PyPI, npm, crates.io, Go, Maven, RubyGems
